2608.26870.title: C-Unseen: Weak Signal Detection in Dynamic Temporal Knowledge Graphs via LLM Reasoning
2608.26870.paper_summary: Weak signals are early, low-visibility indicators that precede significant changes before those changes become established. Existing detection methods, based on keyword frequency, topic modeling, or untyped graph topology, fail to capture the semantic and relational structure through which such signals manifest. In this paper, we propose C-Unseen, a self-interpretable framework for weak signal detection in Dynamic Temporal Knowledge Graphs (DTKGs). We define a weak signal as a rare, semantically coherent subgraph that proliferates across consecutive TKG snapshots. The framework operates through two modules: a Rare Subgraphs Extractor, in which an LLM identifies subgraphs whose content is in tension with the dominant snapshot narrative via chain-of-thought reasoning, and a Weak Signal Alerter, in which the persistence of these rare subgraphs is tracked across time steps to isolate true weak signals. Experimental results demonstrate that C-Unseen outperforms keyword-, topic-, and graph-based baselines.
2608.26870.paper_summary_zh: 弱信號是早期、低可見度的指標，預示著重大變化在這些變化成為既定事實之前的情況。現有的檢測方法，基於關鍵字頻率、主題建模或未類型化的圖拓撲，無法捕捉這些信號顯現的語義和關係結構。在本文中，我們提出了C-Unseen，一個自我解釋的框架，用於在動態時間知識圖（DTKGs）中檢測弱信號。我們將弱信號定義為一個稀有的、語義一致的子圖，該子圖在連續的TKG快照中擴散。該框架通過兩個模組運作：一個稀有子圖提取器，其中LLM通過思維鏈推理識別與主導快照敘事存在緊張關係的子圖，以及一個弱信號警報器，其中這些稀有子圖的持續性在時間步驟中被跟蹤，以孤立真正的弱信號。實驗結果表明，C-Unseen的表現優於基於關鍵字、主題和圖的基準。
